<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="preview" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#59636B"/>
      <stop offset="0.52" stop-color="#A2A2A3"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#39393B"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="topShade" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity=".72"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="bottomShade" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity=".82"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="5"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#000000"/>

  <!-- system status bar -->
  <text x="22" y="27" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="SF Pro" font-size="20" font-weight="700">9:41</text>
  <g fill="#FFFFFF">
    <rect x="313" y="22" width="3" height="5" rx="1"/>
    <rect x="318" y="19" width="3" height="8" rx="1"/>
    <rect x="323" y="16" width="3" height="11" rx="1"/>
    <rect x="328" y="13" width="3" height="14" rx="1"/>
  </g>
  <g fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.6">
    <circle cx="346" cy="22" r="5"/>
    <line x1="342" y1="26" x2="350" y2="18"/>
    <line x1="343" y1="18" x2="350" y2="25"/>
  </g>
  <rect x="363" y="15" width="21" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="365" y="17" width="15" height="8" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="384" y="19" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- preview shadow and camera preview -->
  <rect x="11" y="68" width="368" height="594" rx="16" fill="#000000" opacity=".65" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
  <rect x="12" y="66" width="366" height="594" rx="16" fill="url(#preview)"/>
  <rect x="12" y="66" width="366" height="235" rx="16" fill="url(#topShade)"/>
  <rect x="12" y="430" width="366" height="230" rx="16" fill="url(#bottomShade)"/>

  <!-- stylized live camera scene -->
  <circle cx="303" cy="151" r="39" fill="#DADADA" opacity=".68"/>
  <polygon points="12,453 105,350 166,416 224,338 378,492 378,660 12,660" fill="#646464" opacity=".78"/>
  <polygon points="12,508 91,430 145,474 205,401 378,551 378,660 12,660" fill="#3F3F3F" opacity=".86"/>
  <rect x="245" y="424" width="63" height="117" rx="3" fill="#24262B" opacity=".86"/>
  <polygon points="232,424 277,388 321,424" fill="#24262B" opacity=".88"/>
  <rect x="262" y="471" width="13" height="19" fill="#DADADA" opacity=".55"/>
  <rect x="286" y="471" width="13" height="19" fill="#DADADA" opacity=".55"/>
  <rect x="271" y="506" width="18" height="35" fill="#000000" opacity=".72"/>
  <line x1="12" y1="561" x2="378" y2="561" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity=".18" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="195" y1="66" x2="195" y2="660" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity=".14" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="12" y1="363" x2="378" y2="363" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity=".14" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- preview top controls -->
  <g fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".94">
    <circle cx="35" cy="91" r="17" fill="#FFFFFF33"/>
    <polyline points="40,84 32,91 40,98" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="32" y1="91" x2="47" y2="91" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="355" cy="91" r="17" fill="#FFFFFF33"/>
    <circle cx="355" cy="89" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <polyline points="348,98 351,94 359,94 363,98" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- timer -->
  <text x="195" y="108" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="SF Pro" font-size="20" font-weight="700">01:56</text>
  <line x1="166" y1="120" x2="224" y2="120" stroke="#FFFFFF99" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- zoom control -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="195" cy="607" r="25" fill="#FFFFFF33" stroke="#FFFFFF99" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="607" r="21" fill="#000000" opacity=".26"/>
    <text x="195" y="613" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="SF Pro" font-size="13" font-weight="600">2x</text>
  </g>

  <!-- translucent camera controls -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="45" cy="614" r="20" fill="#FFFFFF33"/>
    <line x1="38" y1="614" x2="52" y2="614" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="45" y1="607" x2="45" y2="621" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="45" cy="614" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="345" cy="614" r="20" fill="#FFFFFF33"/>
    <circle cx="339" cy="610" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <circle cx="351" cy="618" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <polyline points="342,598 348,598 346,603" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <polyline points="348,630 342,630 344,625" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  </g>

  <!-- shutter area -->
  <circle cx="195" cy="705" r="43" fill="#FFFFFF33"/>
  <circle cx="195" cy="705" r="34" fill="#FAFAFA"/>
  <circle cx="195" cy="705" r="29" fill="none" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- flash and gallery controls -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="65" cy="704" r="22" fill="#FFFFFF33"/>
    <polygon points="66,686 56,705 64,705 61,722 75,700 67,700" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="325" cy="704" r="22" fill="#FFFFFF33"/>
    <rect x="312" y="692" width="26" height="22" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="325" cy="703" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="317" cy="697" r="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>

  <!-- mode navigation bar -->
  <rect x="10" y="767" width="370" height="49" rx="24" fill="#FFFFFF33" stroke="#FFFFFF33" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g fill="#FFFFFF99">
    <circle cx="38" cy="786" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF99" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="84" y="781" width="12" height="10" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF99" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="143" cy="786" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF99" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="196" y="781" width="12" height="10" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF99" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="253" y="780" width="14" height="12" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF99" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="313" cy="786" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF99" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="352" y1="781" x2="352" y2="792" stroke="#FFFFFF99" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="347" y1="786" x2="357" y2="786" stroke="#FFFFFF99" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>
  <rect x="12" y="767" width="66" height="49" rx="24" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="45" cy="786" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.7"/>
  <text x="45" y="808" text-anchor="middle" fill="#000000" font-family="SF Pro" font-size="12" font-weight="600">PHOTO</text>
  <text x="101" y="808" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF99" font-family="SF Pro" font-size="12" font-weight="600">VIDEO</text>
  <text x="159" y="808" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF99" font-family="SF Pro" font-size="12" font-weight="600">AUDIO</text>
  <text x="223" y="808" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF99" font-family="SF Pro" font-size="12" font-weight="600">TEXT</text>
  <text x="302" y="808" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF99" font-family="SF Pro" font-size="12" font-weight="600">IMAGE</text>

  <!-- home indicator -->
  <rect x="128" y="835" width="133" height="6" rx="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
</svg>
